Class Motions

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.animation.Motions
public final class Motions extends Object
Composable movement, size, color and opacity declarations; no Minecraft classes or native dependencies.

      public static Timeline randomSpots(int count, double interval, MotionBounds bounds, long seed, Consumer<Animator.Context> onSpot)
      Visits a seeded sequence of positions, updates the RGB tint and calls an action at each stop.
      Parameters:
      count - number of spots, one to 1024
      interval - seconds between spots
      bounds - movement area
      seed - reproducible random seed
      onSpot - borrowed action after position/color updates
      Returns:
      reusable finite sequence
